subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy, second and third editions, as documents
what_would_settle_it: The published strategy text or the Supreme Cybersecurity Council decision adopting it, with an issue date and edition number

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National emergency readiness centre incident and advisory record
what_would_settle_it: An annual report or regulator incident statistics giving reported incidents, sectors affected and response times for 2025 or 2026

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Critical information infrastructure protection regulation
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or cabinet instrument designating critical information infrastructure and setting security obligations on its operators, including the data centres now being licensed

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Submarine cable protection regime for Egyptian waters
what_would_settle_it: An Egyptian instrument on cable protection zones, anchoring restrictions or repair-vessel access; the analysis the wiki holds is Africa-wide and names none for Egypt

subject: infra.connect
name: Egypt's internet exchange points
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or exchange-registry entry naming Egypt's exchange points, their members and peak traffic; nothing in the base names one, which sits oddly against the 15% content-locality reading

subject: infra.connect
name: 2Africa Egyptian landing stations and ready-for-service dates
what_would_settle_it: The consortium's landing-station list or the incumbent's segment announcements naming the Egyptian Mediterranean and Red Sea landings

subject: infra.connect
name: National broadband plan and any universal service obligation or fund
what_would_settle_it: The published national broadband plan or the regulator instrument establishing a universal service fund, with coverage targets and a financing line

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G coverage and subscriber base
what_would_settle_it: A regulator quarterly bulletin giving 5G population coverage, base-station count and subscribers; the equivalent is held for Morocco and Tunisia in the same source and absent for Egypt

subject: infra.store
name: Egypt's total operational data-centre capacity in MW
what_would_settle_it: A market report or regulator licence register giving installed and pipeline IT load by facility

subject: infra.store
name: Government data centres, location, operator and capacity
what_would_settle_it: A ministry or cabinet statement enumerating the state's own data centres; the base repeatedly refers to government data-centre projects and giant data centres without naming or siting one

subject: infra.store
name: Regional Data Hub 2 entry into service
what_would_settle_it: An operator press release or annual report confirming commissioning, Tier III constructed-facility certification, and delivered IT load

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply arrangements for Egypt's operating data centres
what_would_settle_it: A grid connection agreement, tariff schedule or power purchase agreement for any licensed Egyptian data centre; the base holds nothing beyond the Sinai green-power proposal

subject: infra.energy
name: Data-centre energy and water consumption reporting
what_would_settle_it: A licence condition or operator sustainability report giving power usage effectiveness, annual energy draw or cooling-water use for an Egyptian facility

subject: infra.capacity
name: National high-performance computing or public GPU capacity
what_would_settle_it: A ministry or applied innovation centre statement giving the compute on which the Arabic large language model was trained and is served, with location and ownership

subject: dpi.id
name: National digital identity enrolment count
what_would_settle_it: A ministry or interior ministry registration figure for the digital identity app, the interior biometric platform or the central bank identity app; three biometric identity channels launched inside the window and the base holds no enrolment number for any

subject: dpi.id
name: Governing instrument for digital identity and biometric processing
what_would_settle_it: A decree or law establishing the national digital identity system and its biometric processing basis; the data-protection law and its regulations are held, but no identity-specific instrument is

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Register of bodies connected to the government digital switch, and its lawful basis
what_would_settle_it: A ministry or cabinet decree establishing the switch, or a published register of the 105 connected bodies and 100 linked databases; only a cabinet readout of ministry-reported counts is held

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Relationship between the ministry's digital post box and the postal service's product
what_would_settle_it: A ministry statement naming the digital post box product, or the postal service protocol text; the ministry reported its own digital post box as being finalised on 2026-07-19 and a national-ID-linked postbox appeared as operating on 2026-08-05, and nothing states whether these are the same system

subject: dpi.registry
name: National land registration coverage
what_would_settle_it: A real estate publicity department or justice ministry figure for registered against unregistered properties, or a count of survey sections converted to the title register

subject: dpi.registry
name: Commercial register size and digitisation state
what_would_settle_it: A supply ministry or investment authority figure for registered establishments; the base records nine commercial-registry services made exclusive to the platform from 2026-01-01 but no register size or digitisation coverage

subject: dpi.mis
name: Universal Health Insurance system enrolment and digital architecture
what_would_settle_it: An insurance authority enrolment or governorate-rollout figure; the base holds a policy note proposing automatic enrolment and a note that the national digital health strategy is anchored on the insurance architecture, but no operating position

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education management information system
what_would_settle_it: A Ministry of Education statement or system name; education appears only as one of nine priority sectors and as an area receiving new services, with no named system

subject: dpi.pay
name: National card scheme current issuance
what_would_settle_it: A central bank figure for national scheme cards issued after end-2024; 43.5m at end-2024 is the newest count held, repeated in two November 2025 accounts of the same address

subject: dpi.pay
name: Central bank national payment system statistics
what_would_settle_it: A payment systems annual or quarterly report giving mobile money and switch transaction volumes and values; the base carries only inclusion rates quoted second-hand

subject: digital.localgov
name: Governorate-level service platforms and local-government information systems
what_would_settle_it: A local development ministry statement on governorate digital service centres or a local-government information system; the base holds the shop-licensing platform and nothing on governorate-level systems as such

subject: data.statistics
name: Statistics agency release programme and publication calendar
what_would_settle_it: The agency's published release calendar or its statistical yearbook for 2025 or 2026; the base holds no agency output at all beyond the census-planning readout

subject: data.satellite
name: Egypt's own earth-observation and satellite programme
what_would_settle_it: An Egyptian Space Agency statement or satellite mission record; the section's only satellite content is Egypt's intended use of a Japanese rainfall product

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital service uptake, as distinct from rural connectivity
what_would_settle_it: A figure for platform transactions or service-centre usage originating in Decent Life villages; the base holds fibre-line and village counts but nothing on whether rural households use the digital services those lines carry

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection regulator enforcement and licensing record
what_would_settle_it: An annual report or published decisions register giving decisions issued, fines imposed, officers registered and cross-border-transfer licences granted since 2025-11-01

subject: gov.legislate
name: Executive Regulations 816 of 2025, the instrument itself
what_would_settle_it: The Official Gazette text of the decree; the base holds only two law-firm summaries of it

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime Law 175 of 2018 and its enforcement record
what_would_settle_it: The Official Gazette text with any amendments, plus prosecution or conviction statistics; the base names the law repeatedly but holds no text and no enforcement record

subject: gov.legislate
name: Telecommunication Regulation Law 10 of 2003
what_would_settle_it: The Official Gazette text as amended; the base knows it only through the recital in the regulator's satellite framework and a second-hand reference to one article

subject: gov.regional
name: Egypt's position on the AU Malabo Convention
what_would_settle_it: The AU depositary's ratification list, or an Egyptian instrument of ratification or accession; nothing states whether Egypt has signed, ratified or acceded

subject: geopol.eu
name: EU-Egypt digital cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: The text of any EU-Egypt digital chapter, Global Gateway package allocation or European Commission adequacy assessment naming Egypt; the base holds nothing on Egypt's digital relationship with the EU as an institution

subject: data.open
name: Egyptian national open-data portal
what_would_settle_it: The portal's own landing page with a dataset count and a licence statement, or the text of the open data policy the ICT minister referred to on 2025-12-21

subject: gov.discourse
name: Public consultation on the data-protection Executive Regulations
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or ministry consultation record - a draft published for comment, submissions received, or a response document; the base holds no evidence the Regulations were consulted on before issue

subject: gov.policy
name: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, second edition, the document
what_would_settle_it: The published strategy text giving the six pillars' content, targets, budget and delivery milestones now known only from ministerial summaries

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Egypt's AI-specific statute or regulation
what_would_settle_it: A published bill or Official Gazette instrument; nothing establishes any AI-specific law, only the data-protection law and a cabinet-agreed legislative review of 2026-07-29

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI (2023)
what_would_settle_it: The charter text itself; the base carries only the minister's one-line reference to its 2023 issuance

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Applied Innovation Centre
what_would_settle_it: A founding instrument, budget line or annual report; the centre is named in three sources as the developer of the Arabic model but has no establishment date, mandate or funding on file

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Artificial intelligence contribution to Egyptian GDP
what_would_settle_it: The study behind the widely quoted figure of about US$42.7bn or 7.7% of GDP by 2030; no source on file establishes it, and the entity page expressly declines to carry it

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state technology investment in Egypt
what_would_settle_it: Any source at all; the wiki holds zero Egypt sources on this subject, so no UAE, Saudi or Qatari technology or data-centre commitment can be stated, dated or sized

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: India-Egypt technology cooperation
what_would_settle_it: Any source at all; the wiki holds zero Egypt sources on this subject, so no bilateral IT, digital-public-infrastructure or outsourcing arrangement with India can be stated

subject: finance.budget
name: State appropriation for digital transformation and for the ICT ministry
what_would_settle_it: The finance ministry's published FY2026/2027 budget chapters for the communications ministry, or the ICT chapter of the Economic and Social Development Plan; there is no budget archive for Egypt and the plan document is not held

subject: finance.budget
name: Economic and Social Development Plan FY2026/2027
what_would_settle_it: The plan document from the planning ministry or as laid before Parliament; the wiki records at 2026-08-04 that it is not held and that the ministry site serves no plan document

subject: finance.budget
name: Startup Charter EGP 50bn financing initiative, appropriation and disbursement
what_would_settle_it: The cabinet decision or finance law establishing the fund, and the managing body's first disbursement report

subject: capacity.research
name: Applied Innovation Centre research programme and model documentation
what_would_settle_it: The centre's own published research output, budget or model card; nothing at all is held on research capacity for Egypt

subject: capacity.research
name: National research and development spending on artificial intelligence and digital technologies
what_would_settle_it: A statistics agency or higher education ministry expenditure series, or the National AI Strategy's own budget annex

subject: capacity.research
name: Compute access for Egyptian researchers
what_would_settle_it: A dated statement from the AI-factory operator or the Egyptian state on the Egyptian site's siting, capacity and access terms; the base records only that Egypt is one of five planned sites

subject: capacity.training
name: Enrolment and graduate numbers for the named national training programmes
what_would_settle_it: Ministry or IT industry agency annual reports giving per-programme intake and completion figures; the base names the vehicles at 2026-07-21 but carries no numbers

subject: include.access
name: Internet use as a share of population
what_would_settle_it: Regulator or ministry monthly ICT indicators, or an ITU country profile; no source in the base carries an Egyptian internet-penetration figure with a citable URL

subject: include.access
name: Universal service fund or universal service obligation
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual report or the universal-service provisions of the telecommunications law and any levy accounts; no source names such a fund

subject: include.access
name: Postal service digital services and post-office digitisation
what_would_settle_it: A national postal authority progress report; the base holds only 2024 figures of 27 digital services and about 3,000 post offices digitised, with no update

subject: include.divides
name: Gender gap in internet and mobile-internet use
what_would_settle_it: An industry association gender-gap country table or a statistics agency ICT household survey for Egypt; only the mobile-money literacy split is held

subject: include.divides
name: Affordability of connectivity relative to income
what_would_settle_it: An affordability alliance or ITU affordability series for Egypt; the base records rising consumer complaints about internet prices at December 2025 but no price or income measure
